description: Find current public sales (yard and garage sales, whole-house sales, auctions, flea markets, shops) by keyword, city, ZIP, map point, date range or sale type. Returns sale summaries with approximate location and a link to each sale page. Street addresses are never included.

endDate.description: Only sales starting on or before this date (YYYY-MM-DD)

lat.description: Latitude for a radius search (use with lng)

lng.description: Longitude for a radius search (use with lat)

minConfidence.description: Minimum listing confidence 0 to 1. 0.7 = organizer-verified, 0.4 = corroborated by a third party.

query.description: Keywords to match in the sale title or description, e.g. "mid-century" or "tools"

radiusKm.description: Radius in kilometers for lat/lng search (default 25)

saleType.description: Sale type code: ESTATE (whole-house sale), YARD (yard or garage sale), AUCTION, FLEA_MARKET, RETAIL (shop or storefront, incl. consignment), DORM_DASH (dorm move-out).

startDate.description: Only sales starting on or after this date (YYYY-MM-DD)

name: search_sales
title: Search Sales
